info.title: PhotoAtomic i18n pre-translation tool
info.description: dotnet tool companion for PhotoAtomic.Internationalization: extracts the catalog from a csproj (Razor included), pre-translates missing entries and verifies catalog completeness. Install with `dotnet tool install PhotoAtomic.Internationalization.Tool`.

options.name: --all
options.description:
THE ONE COMMAND. Prunes what the code no longer says, translates
the values, then the sentences (in that order: sentences are
declined against the words already translated), then lints and
repairs round after round until it stops improving. Ends with the
list of what a human still has to look at — and moves those rows
to the END of the CSV, so opening the file lands on the work.

options.name: --verify
options.description: no translation: checks that every catalog unit has rows for

options.name: --lint
options.description: no translation: reads the rows themselves and reports what is

options.name: --fix
options.description: repairs what the lint found: from the table where possible,
